task: Phase 2 task 010: per-segment popover + keyboard-reachable detail for SegmentRenderMonitor

frontend/src/components/progress/Segment.summary: Adds click/tap interaction to the 10-60 full-strip mode: clicking a (still aria-hidden, decorative) block opens a container-anchored 'SegmentDetailPopover' (role="dialog", NOT aria-hidden) showing segment index, phase, engine id, a client-observed elapsed-time proxy (no server started_at exists on the wire, so this is time-since-first-observed-in-rendering/failed by this client, not a true server duration), reason_code, and (failed only) a Retry button. New optional prop 'onRetry?: (segmentId: string) => void' — the component stays presentational and does not call the API itself. New optional field 'reasonCode?: string' on SegmentRenderMonitorSegment (maps ActiveSegmentMapEntry.reason_code). SegmentAccessibleTable gained an 'Actions' column with 'Details'/'Retry' buttons (new required props onOpenDetail/onRetry) providing the M6-mandated keyboard-reachable equivalent to the popover — verified via a keyboard-only interaction test that never touches the aria-hidden block field. Positioning follows ScriptView.tsx's selection-popover pattern (container-relative getBoundingClientRect, no new popover primitive introduced).

frontend/src/hooks/useSegmentInventory.t.summary: Maps ActiveSegmentMapEntry.reason_code -> SegmentRenderMonitorSegment.reasonCode, and prefers liveEntry.engine_id (task 008 field) over the job-level engine as the per-segment engineId when present.

frontend/src/pages/Activity/ActivityPage.summary: Wires SegmentRenderMonitor's new onRetry prop to 'api.generateSegments([segmentId])' — the same per-segment (re)generation endpoint ScriptView/BoothTool/ReviseTool already use for single-segment re-render; there is no server-side 'retry' verb, so this IS the real per-segment retry granularity available today (not chapter-level). Calls onRefresh() after a successful requeue; logs (does not surface via toast) on failure, matching this page's existing error-handling level.

frontend/tests/unit/components/progress/.summary: Adds mouse-click popover-open/detail/retry-wiring tests and a keyboard-only test (tab + Enter through the accessible table's Details/Retry buttons) proving the M6 keyboard-reachable path never touches the aria-hidden block field.

flow_impact: SegmentRenderMonitor gains its first interactive affordance (previously 100% static): a per-segment detail popover reachable by mouse (via the decorative block) or keyboard (via the accessible table's new Details/Retry buttons), and a real segment-level retry action wired through to the existing /api/segments/generate endpoint via ActivityPage. No change to the M1-M3 render/aggregate contract or to task 009's milestone aria-live region.
